question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given figure when the mirror is placed at MN as shown.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b29b2776520f8b79456332828676643b1104ae3d8328dff775749f0b3d0fd3b4.png]
solution:
**Explanation:**

The correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at MN is as shown below:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/605561598a9f067d2bdd4148b2e93df3e7e4253e6116877a400418473d72a4bd.png] 

__Detailed Explanation__ :- 

__
 
• The line MN is the mirror.
 
• The word [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cd6cc43813b07118c2c0363c900b3b05a0e67463f81ff8317eaea80d12c953d.png] ends with [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68144144e9056b9a1cc2ae09d8aa8116e371b1a37d2465bdef7614b710d411f6.png] . So, the mirror image will start with [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6dc986fd8c81e07254583b9353b230ca7301c173a0372a08f7c5ebe77c3e41c9.png] → Options 2, 3, 4 are eliminated.

Hence, Option 1 is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• In a mirror image Left changes to right and the right changes to left where top and bottom remains the same.

 
• When placement of mirror not given, by default we will assume it in vertical direction.
 
• The starting letter word will be at last after the mirror image drawn with left changes to right and right changes to left.
